name: un_get_sdg_targets
description:
List the targets of one UN Sustainable Development Goal (e.g. 3.1, 3.2 under Goal 3), from the UN Statistics Division SDG API (no API key).
Returns: sdg_code, sdg_title, targets (code, title, description, uri) and count; on failure an error and note instead.
Inputs (* required): sdg_code* (string "1" to "17").
For the measurable indicators under each target use un_get_sdg_indicators; for the goals themselves un_get_sdgs.
Example: {"sdg_code": "3"}

targets.description: List of specific targets for this SDG

description.description: Detailed target description with specific measurable objectives

uri.description: UN SDG API URI for this target

count.description: Number of targets for this SDG

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Targets break down each SDG into specific, measurable objectives. For example, SDG 1 (No Poverty) includes targets like 1.1 (eradicate extreme poverty) and 1.2 (reduce poverty by half).

examples.description: Get all targets for SDG 1 (No Poverty)
Get all targets for SDG 7 (Affordable and Clean Energy)
Get all targets for SDG 13 (Climate Action)

useCases: Understand specific objectives within an SDG
